name: Cat Skull Combat (Combat, Style)
body:
The killing arts of the kreyu prey on the unwary and unprepared.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +1, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: When using this style and attacking during the surprise round with an unarmed strike, you gain a +2 bonus on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn. Special: This style’s benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
